name: The Wandering Minstrel
oracle_text:
Lands you control enter untapped.
The Minstrel's Ballad — At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control five or more Towns, create a 2/2 Elemental creature token that's all colors.
{3}{W}{U}{B}{R}{G}: Other creatures you control get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of Towns you control.
blocked_sentences: The Minstrel's Ballad — At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control five or more Towns, create a 2/2 Elemental creature token that's all colors.

needs.what: a 2/2 white blue black red green Elemental creature token ("a 2/2 Elemental creature token that's all colors")
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids has elemental_2_2_g (green only) and other Elementals of different sizes and colors, and create_token takes no colors override (its options are amount, as, attached_to, attacking, controller, counters, or_planeswalker, player, power, tapped, token, toughness), so the all-colors token cannot be made. The rest of the card is expressible: enters_untapped static, a begin_combat trigger with a Town count condition, and a pump over other creatures by Town count.
